prompt:
Create a polished LANDSCAPE DIPTYCH: TWO ORIGINAL ALTERNATIVE ILLUSTRATIONS for the SAME educational theme, placed side by side in two equal SQUARE panels, separated by a thin off-white gutter. NO TEXT, no labels, no signatures. The provided triptych is the APPROVED STYLE DIRECTION reference, not an edit target: faithfully match its late 1950s/1960s Atomic Age cartoon editorial drawing, witty elongated forms, asymmetry, boomerang curves, irregular expressive black ink contours sometimes offset from flat color, confident hand-designed shape invention. Not corporate SVG clipart, not photorealism, not a natural history engraving. Both options must be substantially different in subjects/composition but equal in quality and belong to the same family as the reference telescope and leopard. Flat opaque colors with NO texture, grain, halftone, gradients, rendering or shadows. Neutral near-white #F8F8F3 background, never yellow/beige paper. Lots of air around each main subject, medium level of stylization and detail that reads when reduced to ~120px. One main focal subject, at most two small supporting accents per square. Very important PERMANENT PROHIBITION: NO clusters of three short strokes, NO three radiating ticks, NO three-stroke fans, NO emphasis/motion rays. Do NOT use this decoration anywhere. Atomic starbursts or a single elliptical orbital line are allowed but restrained. Use one clear theme-dominant color with a small brighter accent; fine dark ink and ivory negative space. Keep graceful strong silhouettes, playful sophisticated vintage science-book personality. Neither option should be merely an icon, or be overloaded with little objects. 
Theme HUMAN BODY. Dominant dusty rose/coral, small vivid turquoise accent. LEFT OPTION 1: a graceful stylized human figure in a dynamic stretching pose, elegant angular limbs and a simplified visible ribcage/heart motif on the torso, a single small floating DNA double-helix accent. Friendly adult-neutral educational character with expressive 1950s line economy, not a medical cross/first aid icon, not a child. RIGHT OPTION 2: an expressive large open human hand in an elegant gesture, fingers anatomically readable and intentionally stylized, palm showing a subtle clean anatomical bone diagram with just a few selected bone lines, small rose heart beside it. Inventive confident contours, no creepy or damaged anatomy, no overcrowding.
correction: Edit this two-panel illustration very carefully. Preserve the entire LEFT illustration exactly: the stretching human figure with DNA helix. In the RIGHT illustration, the anatomical hand currently has only THREE long fingers and a thumb. Correct it into a graceful human hand with FOUR separate long fingers (index, middle, ring and little finger) PLUS one thumb, for FIVE total digits. Each finger should have clear joints and simplified ivory bone shapes coherent with the existing style. Keep the same overall hand pose, coral color, slender expressive tapered line style, off-white background, heart with turquoise orbit, star, panel dimensions and balance. Make space for a correct little finger at the top LEFT edge of the hand next to the existing ring finger. No new decorations, no emphasis rays or clusters of three strokes. This is a precise anatomy correction, not a redesign. Check count: four long fingers + one thumb.
